description: The runtime of a Store model's package on a Runner: it creates, expands and contracts the model's tables as the Runner tasks deploy and contract. The Store server was deleted (plan 33 SC23). Needs the .NET 10 runtime.
notes: A Runner starts it as dbdatastore --runner for a model's tasks; it has no commands of its own. A Store model is authored in a store project of the Workspace and deployed from its Deploy tab.
